record.scope: Actual verified UCI endpoint, all threads; launcher/bootstrap CPU remains in the full Job.

endpoint_resolution.allowed_scope: Only the frozen Sunfish -u script venv launcher and its unique direct frozen base-Python child; wrapper startup CPU excluded from endpoint CPU and retained in owned Job CPU. At most one explicitly frozen conhost helper; helper CPU excluded from endpoint CPU and retained in owned Job CPU. No other observed descendants.
endpoint_resolution.scope: Sampled exact image/creation/parent proof; held during resolution. CPU meter must recheck pid and creation. No whole-system or future-descendant guarantee.

endpoint_resolution.allowed_scope: Frozen native profile image itself. At most one explicitly frozen conhost helper; helper CPU excluded from endpoint CPU and retained in owned Job CPU. No other observed descendants.
endpoint_resolution.scope: Sampled exact image/creation/parent proof; held during resolution. CPU meter must recheck pid and creation. No whole-system or future-descendant guarantee.
